reason: Disaster Recovery is an operational recovery contract over existing application/data boundaries; it introduces no new business entity, aggregate, endpoint DTO, or persistence invariant in product code.
operational_invariants: Never restore over the active source database.
Recovery candidate must be isolated/new until validation succeeds.
Application rollback selects immutable known-good revisions.
Durable MySQL engineering RPO baseline is <=24h until a tighter PITR objective is measured and accepted.
Outbound business side effects stay disabled during recovery-candidate sanity.
P0=0 and P1=0 are mandatory before cutover recommendation.
Failed recovery candidates are not promoted and do not overwrite the only known-good copy.
